source.title: Ethereum Gas Tracker | Etherscan
source.captureMethod: Direct HTTPS GET of the public official page; browser-search fetch returned HTTP 403, direct HTTPS returned 200.

extraction.average: span#spanAvgPrice (page avgPrice / averageGas value, in the Fast card)
extraction.ethUsd: ETH Price header link /chart/etherprice; cross-checked against lastCryptoCompareUsdPrice

sstoreOnlyEstimate.arithmetic: Python decimal.Decimal; no binary floating-point arithmetic
sstoreOnlyEstimate.assumption: 32 payload slots * 20,000 gas per zero-to-nonzero SSTORE under the assignment's historical simplified model; excludes the array length and every other cost.

remixFirstPutEquivalent.arithmetic: Python decimal.Decimal; no binary floating-point arithmetic
remixFirstPutEquivalent.interpretation: Mainnet-equivalent USD estimate at the captured Etherscan quote; not actual spending on Remix or the Sepolia testnet.

notes: All price and money values are decimal strings; timestamps are UTC as requested.
The timestamp is when this HTML quote was retrieved, not an invented Etherscan market tick timestamp.
Gas and ETH/USD prices fluctuate; these are the values in the preserved source snapshot.
The historical 640,000-gas calculation follows the question's simplifying assumption; it is not a universal current SSTORE schedule.
